items.name: Makeshift 4 Mirror Armor +1
items.description: This armor consists of four glaucite plates harnessed together with leather shoulder straps. Two round plates protect your front and back, while two smaller rectangular plates cover the sides of the torso. Four-mirror armor is worn over chainmail to provide added protection, and comes with a spiked helmet with a chainmail hood.

items.name: Scrapwall Greatersword
items.description: This blade was made from unbreakable space metal scraps and enchanted by weeks of constant prayer for the death of one's enemies.

items.name: Arrow
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 22, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143

Statistics
Cost 1 gp Weight 3 lbs.

Category Ammunition; Proficiency Ammunition

Description
An arrow used as a melee weapon is treated as a light improvised weapon (-4 penalty on attack rolls) and deals damage as a dagger of its size (critical multiplier x2).

Arrows come in a leather quiver that holds 20 arrows.

items.name: Scrap Horn
items.description:
This "horn" is more of a metal trumpet without the instrument bit. It is fashioned from re-purposed armor plates, many of which still have bullet/arrow holes and dents from battle.
The item is heavily enchanted by months of ritual prayer. The prayers focused on found-family unity and the device now provides several benefits.
All effects require yelling into the megaphone.
1) Communal buff-spells have their duration doubled and affect twice as many targets. This includes communal cure-spells.
